# Install the required file(s)
foreach f ($FILES)
if (-f $LIBX11/$f) then
    echo "Preserving old $f file in $LIBX11/$f.old"
    mv $LIBX11/$f $LIBX11/$f.old
endif
echo "Copying $f to $LIBX11"
cp $SYNOPSYS/admin/setup/$f $LIBX11
diff $SYNOPSYS/admin/setup/$f $LIBX11/$f >& /dev/null

endif
chmod 444 $LIBX11/$f
